items.content_html: I built this to practice full-stack fundamentals and apply basic quant ideas. The app fetches market data via Yahoo Finance (yfinance on the backend), calculates SMA(50/200), RSI-14, and volume vs. average volume, and rolls those into a 1–5 star score. A lightweight backtester replays past periods to see how signals would have performed.

items.content_html: This project is a lightweight, web-based crop disease detection system powered by machine learning.
